Convert to mpg. 8.2L per 100km ~ 100km = 62.137 miles. So 8.2L per 62.137 miles. That's 1 L per 7.58 miles. 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 1 gallon gives 7.58*3.78541 = 28.7 miles. So fuel efficiency ~28.7 mpg. For 750 miles need 750/28.7 = 26.1 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. Current 10 gallons. Need 16.1 gallons. Round maybe 17 gallons. Let's request fillFuelTank 17 gallons.
